thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for SERVICE: db-cache-prod (critical)
pagerduty: Incident PD-76542 triggered, priority: P1, symptom: high db connection saturation + redis maxclients, affected: api-prod-us-east-1
alex: acked oncall. I'm on it — pulling metrics now.
maya: i'm awake, pinged db-team. what's the customer impact? any 5xx spikes?
alex: 5xxs up ~2.4x for write-heavy endpoints. latency cpu for primary pg ~350ms, connection queueing visible in pgbouncer stats. redis `maxclients` errors in logs.
jia: I'm jumping in as db oncall. checking pgbouncer and primary pg. pgbouncer shows 100% active clients, waiters increasing.
sam: redis node r-prod-03 showing many `ERR max number of clients reached`. evictions spiking. looks like a client is opening many short-lived connections.
ops-lead: @db-team, recommend immediate mitigation: enable pgbouncer overflow mode, raise `max_client_conn` temporarily, and scale read-replicas if possible. Also consider throttling the client.
db-team: Agree. Jia, can you run `SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active';` and also check `pgbouncer SHOW POOLS;` ?
jia: Ran both. pg active connections: 1220 (normal cap ~600). pgbouncer POOLS shows many clients queued on `write_pool_1`. copy/paste logs:
```
pg_stat_activity: active=1220, idle=230, waiting=410
pgbouncer SHOW POOLS:
write_pool_1: clients=980, active=600, waiters=380
```
alex: I see a recent deploy from the recommendations service 5m ago. Rolling back might help. Any quick filter to identify noisy client IPs in pgbouncer logs? maya, can you open the deploy dashboard and freeze that rollout?
maya: Freeze issued on recommendations-service v3.4.7 — halted new traffic. Also added temporary rate-limit rule on the edge for that service (`X-Client-Service: recommendations` to 10 rps) using the api-gateway bypass.
sam: For redis, I'm prepping a rolling restart of r-prod-03 and bumping `maxclients` from 10000 to 15000 on the other two nodes to absorb traffic. Will clear ephemeral connections after restart.
redis-bot: Initiating rolling restart on r-prod-03 (cordon -> restart -> healthcheck). ETA ~ 90s per node.
alex: Jia, can you open a pgbouncer config patch to enable `max_client_conn` -> 8000 and `reserve_pool_timeout` -> 10s? We need to avoid immediate rejects while we drain the noisy service.
jia: Pushed config change to pgbouncer staging, running `pgbouncer -R` on a single pool to reload. Patch ID: cfg-9342. Applying to primary now.
ops-lead: Also add quick fallback — enable read-only routing for non-critical reads so writes have headroom.
db-team: Enabling read-only routing now. `ALTER ROLE webapp SET default_transaction_read_only = true;` applied on replica pool. Should offload a chunk.
alex: Customer impact update: Payment and checkout endpoints are experiencing increased latency (95th 1.2s -> 3.5s) and a small percentage of failures (~0.8% of requests). Support has been notified.
maya: Support note prepared: "We are investigating database and cache saturation affecting API latency. Engineering mitigation in progress. No data loss expected. Status updates every 15 minutes." Posting to status.redwood.ai now.
sam: r-prod-03 restarted, healthchecks green. Redis `maxclients` still high but errors dropping. evictions lower.
jia: pgbouncer reload applied to primary. Connections accepted increased, waiters down to 60.
alex: Good. I'm going to run a short SQL to identify the top connection sources by application_name and client_addr:
```
SELECT application_name, client_addr, count(*) as cnt
FROM pg_stat_activity
GROUP BY application_name, client_addr
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
alex: Results show `recommendations-worker` at 540 conns from 10.11.42.77 and `recommendations-job-runner` at 420 conns from 10.11.42.78
maya: Those are the newly-deployed pods — rollback in progress. Deployer shows rollback complete at +3m.
db-team: After rollback, connections from those app names dropped to 40 total within 90s. Waiters now 12. Active conn 640.
ops-lead: Good. Next steps: keep pgbouncer elevated for 15m, monitor, then revert `max_client_conn` to normal. Run postmortem to catch why recommendations-service opened many connections (missing pooling).
alex: I'm tagging CI owner for recommendations to add connection pooling lib and enforce limits. @sam please keep redis nodes under observation for burst reconnects.
sam: watching. will auto-scale redis read replicas if mem/connected_clients crosses thresholds.
oncall-bot: Incident PD-76542 status: mitigated -> partial. Next update due in 15m. PagerDuty will auto-close if no regressions in 30m.
jia: Confirming p95 latency back to ~420ms for most endpoints, checkout stable but monitoring.
maya: Support updated customers in affected orgs. No SEV escalations yet.
ops-lead: Handoff: alex will follow monitoring for 30m, then pass to day oncall (maya) at 08:00. db-team will follow up with a root cause and remediation PR.
alex: ack. I'll leave a short runbook in the incident channel with quick commands and checks.
db-team: Noted. Postmortem owners: jia (db), maya (deploy), alex (oncall). Scheduled RCA meeting tomorrow 10:00.
oncall-bot: PD-76542 closed automatically after 35m without regression. :white_check_mark:
alex: closing thread here — reopen if anything reoccurs. Thanks all for quick responses. :bow:
